question: According to the Koppen climate classification system, ‘Am’ is the code for which type of climate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical monsoon climate**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Koppen climate classification system** is one of the most widely used climate classification systems.
 
• In this system, the code **'Am'** stands for **Tropical monsoon climate**.
 
• This type of climate is characterized by heavy rainfall during the monsoon season and a short dry season.
 
• Regions with this climate typically have lush vegetation and a high level of biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Koppen climate classification system was developed by **Wladimir Koppen**, a German climatologist, in the early 20th century.
 
• The system categorizes climates based on annual and monthly averages of temperature and precipitation.
 
• It is widely used in environmental and ecological studies, as well as in geography and meteorology.
 
• Other major climate types in the Koppen system include **Tropical rainforest (Af)**, **Desert (B)**, and **Temperate (C)** climates.
